The second pathway connects 1,3-Dibenzylurea to Sn1-specific diacylglycerol lipase beta, which is targeted by 2-Hexulosonic acid, and this compound is also targeted by Forkhead box protein O1. While the exact mechanism of interaction between 1,3-Dibenzylurea and Forkhead box protein O1 remains unclear, the evidence suggests that the drug may influence downstream signaling pathways involving anion transport and lipid metabolism, both of which are regulated by Forkhead box protein O1. The integration of these pathways highlights the drug's potential to modulate cellular processes through multiple interconnected molecular mechanisms.
